name: save-boot-32a-choice-route-mds7st1
description: #168 fourth budget, attempt 2 (diagnostic; generated by runner/test/unit/choice-route-scenarios.js). Boot harness/saves/disc1-mds7st1.json (field 144) and load, wait 30 frames, then for each talkable model 7, 5 in turn: route over the walkmesh to its talk range (at most 1800 frames, patience 90, up to 6 detours), face it and tap Interact until a message window opens (at most 600 frames), and press Interact through every waiting window until all are closed; ask 'note' records the first window seen waiting in state 6 with pointerEnabled 1 (a choice; pressing on picks the pointed option). Metrics per model k: o<k> (how the route ended: 1 reached, 2 stuck, 3 timeout, 4 left, 5 no mesh, 6 no goal, 7 no path; 0 not run), r<k> (triangles left on the path to the goal; 1 in a goal triangle, 0 no path), t<k> (frames until a window opened, 0 none) and a<k> (the choice window, index + 1, 0 none). Check: still in field 144. Only those numbers leave.
